items.source: Specific tag of the request for logging and statistical purposes.
items.translation: 请求的特定tag，用于日志记录和统计目的。

items.source: Query in the Lucene query string syntax.
items.translation: Lucene 查询字符串语法中的查询。

items.source: Specifies the node or shard the operation should be performed on.
items.translation: 指定操作应执行的节点或分片。

items.source: Custom value used to route operations to a specific shard.
items.translation: 用于将操作路由到特定分片的自定义值。

items.source: Period to retain the search context for scrolling.
items.translation: 滚动时保留搜索上下文的时长。

items.source: The type of the search operation.
items.translation: 搜索操作的类型。

items.source: Sort search results in a specific order.
items.translation: 按特定顺序对搜索结果进行排序。

items.source: Returns the document version as part of a hit.
items.translation: 作为命中结果的一部分返回文档版本。

items.source: An error will occur if the condition is false and any of the following are true: a wildcard expression, an index alias, or the _all value only targets missing or closed indices. By default, this is set to true.
items.translation: 如果条件为 false，且满足以下任一情况：通配符表达式、索引别名或 `_all` 值仅针对缺失或已关闭的索引，则会出现错误。默认情况下，该值设置为 true。

items.source: An error occurs if it is directed at an index that is missing or closed when it is false. By default, this is set to false.
items.translation: 如果该操作指向的索引在 `<code>false` 时缺失或已关闭，则会发生错误。默认情况下，此值设置为 `<code>false`。

items.source: Refreshes all shards involved in the deleting by query after the request completes when it is true. By default, this is set to false.
items.translation: 当设置为true时，在请求完成后刷新所有参与按查询删除的分片。默认情况下，此选项设置为false。

items.source: An error will occur if the condition is false and any of the following are true: a wildcard expression, an index alias, or the _all value only targets missing or closed indices.
items.translation: 如果条件为false，且满足以下任一情况时会出现错误：通配符表达式、索引别名或_all 值仅针对缺失或已关闭的索引。

items.source: An error occurs if it is directed at an index that is missing or closed when it is false.
items.translation: 如果该操作针对的索引在 `false` 时缺失或已关闭，则会发生错误。

items.source: Refreshes all shards involved in the deleting by query after the request completes when it is true.
items.translation: 当设置为true时，在请求完成后刷新所有参与按查询删除操作的分片。

items.source: Use the request cache when it is true.
items.translation: 当设置为true时，请使用请求缓存。

items.source: If true, wildcard and prefix queries are analyzed. Defaults to false. This parameter can only be used when the lucene query q parameter is specified.
items.translation: 如果为真，则分析通配符和前缀查询。默认为假。此参数仅在指定 lucene 查询q参数时可用。

items.source: Analyzer to use for the query string. This parameter can only be used when the lucene query q parameter is specified.
items.translation: 用于查询字符串的分析器。此参数仅在指定了 Lucene 查询 `q` 参数时可用。

items.source: The default operator for a query string query: AND or OR. Defaults to OR. This parameter can only be used when the lucene query q parameter is specified.
items.translation: 查询字符串查询的默认运算符：AND 或 OR。默认为 OR。此参数仅在指定了 Lucene 查询 `q` 参数时可用。

items.source: Use the request cache when it is true. By default, use the index-level setting.
items.translation: 当设置为true时使用请求缓存。默认情况下，使用索引级别的设置。

items.source: Limited this request to a certain number of sub-requests per second. By default, this is set to -1 (no throttle).
items.translation: 将每秒子请求的数量限制为特定值。默认情况下，此值设置为 `-1`（无节流）。

items.source: Size of the scroll request that powers the operation. By default, this is set to 1000.
items.translation: 操作所驱动的滚动请求的大小。默认情况下，此值设置为 `1000`。

items.source: The number of slices this task should be divided into. By default, this is set to 1 meaning the task isn’t sliced into subtasks.
items.translation: 此任务应分割成的切片数量。默认设置为 `1`，表示该任务不会被分割为子任务。

items.source: Period each deletion request waits for active shards. By default, this is set to 1m (one minute).
items.translation: 每次删除请求都会等待活动分片。默认情况下，该值设置为 `<code>1m`（一分钟）。

items.source: Type of index that wildcard patterns can match.
items.translation: 通配符模式可以匹配的主键类型。

items.source: Analyzer to use for the query string.
items.translation: 用于查询字符串的分析器。

items.source: If true, wildcard and prefix queries are analyzed.
items.translation: 如果为真，则分析通配符和前缀查询。

items.source: Define the types of conflicts that occur when a query encounters version conflicts: abort or proceed.
items.translation: 定义查询遇到版本冲突时发生的冲突类型：中止或继续。

items.source: Field to be used as the default when no field prefix is specified in the query string.
items.translation: 当查询字符串中未指定字段前缀时，将使用此字段作为默认值。

items.source: The default operator for a query string query: AND or OR.
items.translation: 查询字符串查询的默认运算符：AND 或 OR。

items.source:
If a query contains errors related to the format of the data being entered, they will be disregarded unless
specified otherwise.
items.translation: 如果查询中存在与输入数据格式相关的错误，除非另有说明，否则将忽略这些错误。

items.source: Maximum number of documents to process.
items.translation: 要处理的文档最大数量。

items.source: Limited this request to a certain number of sub-requests per second.
items.translation: 将此次请求限制为每秒一定数量的子请求。

items.source: Size of the scroll request that powers the operation.
items.translation: 驱动该操作的滚动请求的大小。

items.source: Explicit timeout for each search request.
items.translation: 每个搜索请求的显式超时时间。

items.source: The number of slices this task should be divided into.
items.translation: 此任务应分割成的切片数量。

items.source: The Maximum number of documents that can be collected for each shard.
items.translation: 每个分片可收集的最大文档数。

items.source: Period each deletion request waits for active shards.
items.translation: 每次删除请求都会等待活动分片。

items.source:
If a query contains errors related to the format of the data being entered, they will be disregarded unless
specified otherwise. By default, this feature is turned off.
items.translation: 如果查询包含与输入数据格式相关的错误，除非另有指定，否则将忽略这些错误。默认情况下，此功能处于关闭状态。

items.source:
Define the types of conflicts that occur when a query encounters version conflicts: abort or proceed. Defaults to
abort.
items.translation: 定义查询遇到版本冲突时发生的冲突类型：中止或继续。默认为中止。

items.source: Type of index that wildcard patterns can match. Defaults to open.
items.translation: 通配符模式可以匹配的索引类型。默认为 open。

items.source: Maximum number of documents to process. Defaults to all documents.
items.translation: 要处理的文档最大数量。默认为所有文档。

items.source: Explicit timeout for each search request. By default, this is set to no timeout.
items.translation: 每个搜索请求的显式超时设置。默认情况下，此值设置为无超时。

items.source:
The Maximum number of documents that can be collected for each shard. If a query exceeds this limit,
Elasticsearch will stop the query.
items.translation: 每个分片可收集的最大文档数。如果查询超过此限制，Elasticsearch 将停止该查询。

items.source: Aouichaoui Youssef
items.translation: 奥伊查乌伊·尤塞夫

items.translation: 当查询字符串中未指定字段前缀时，将使用此字段作为默认值。该参数仅在指定了 Lucene 查询 `q` 参数时可用。
